resources.string: Sync a vault between phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi. Find a device and enter its pairing code, or scan its QR code.
For the first connection, enter the source vault password. The received vault is added separately. For later syncs, select that same vault on both devices.
Pairing expires after 10 minutes. Share this code or QR code only with the device you want to connect.
Pairing code and link filled in automatically. Tap Pair and sync to continue.
Pairing information filled in automatically. Enter the source vault password for the first transfer, then tap Pair and sync.
No local Wi-Fi address was found.
No devices found yet. On the other device, choose “Allow a device to connect”. You can also scan or paste its pairing link.
Waiting for the other device to finish applying changes…
%1$d conflicts need review in vault management. Both versions are preserved.
The received vault has been added to vault management.
These are different vaults. Select the same vault on both devices, or receive this vault as a new one.
Nearby sync is unavailable in this build.
The pairing code is invalid or no longer matches. Get a new code from the other device.
Pairing expired. Allow a device to connect again to create a new code.
The other device could not apply the changes. Check it and retry.
The vault could not be opened or merged. Check the vault password and available storage, then retry.
Check that both devices are still connected to the same Wi-Fi, then pair again. Already committed changes are preserved.
This vault references files stored outside it. Nearby sync currently requires all attachments to be stored inside the vault.
